title: View and navigate documents
summary: Navigate pages, adjust zoom levels, and search text within documents.

sections.heading: Scrolling and Panning
sections.text: Scroll using your mouse wheel or trackpad. Hold the Spacebar and drag with the mouse to pan the document.

sections.heading: Zoom Controls
sections.text: Click the minus and plus buttons on the toolbar to zoom. Select View > Actual Size or View > Zoom to Fit.

sections.heading: Searching Text
sections.text: Click the Search box on the toolbar or press Ctrl + F. Type your search term and press Enter.

steps: Press the Right Arrow key or Left Arrow key to move between pages.
Select Go > Go to Page... or press Ctrl + G to jump directly to a page number.
Press Ctrl + 9 to fit the page to the window, or press Ctrl + 0 for actual size.
note: Press the tilde (~) key or backtick (`) to toggle the circular magnifier loupe.
